text:
id: D-0010
type: decision
title: "Amendment of D-0005 consequence 3: only the OS's own capability server runs hand-declared; every executable plugin runs only with a registration approved for exactly it"
status: ACTIVE
state_class: AUTHORITATIVE
created: "2026-09-19"
updated: "2026-09-19"
owner_role: orchestrator
approved_by_role: orchestrator
supersedes: []
# An amendment by a new governed record: D-0005's text is unchanged; its consequence 3 is read as stated below.
amends: [D-0005]
amended_consequence: "D-0005 consequences[2] (consequence 3)"
governed_by: [PRJ-0001, D-0002, D-0005, D-0007, D-0009]
affects: [D-0005, API-0001]
derived_from: [D-0005]
question: >
  D-0005 consequence 3 states: "Existing hand-declared descriptors keep working for roles at/above L2; lower roles need
  a registered plugin." Contract v3 F4 requires that a descriptor cannot authorise itself, that registration and
  provenance live in trusted OS state, that descriptor and implementation bytes are hash-bound and that drift fails
  closed; ARCH-0003 §9 (owner-adopted) states that plugins are governed executables whose bytes and descriptor
  identity are bound through kernel-owned registration and that descriptors cannot self-authorise. The Phase-2 repair
  of BC-P2-39/40 (P2-AR-0028) implements F4: the OS classifies a plugin by what its command executes, never by what
  its descriptor declares, and runs an executable plugin only with an approved registration. Which statement governs a
  hand-declared descriptor?
options:
  - id: A
    description: >-
      Keep consequence 3 as written: a hand-declared executable plugin runs for a role at/above L2 on its own
      declarations (contradicts Contract v3 F4:426-429 and ARCH-0003 §9; the synthesis of audit-0 found such a plugin
      writing files it never declared, gamma-r F4.b1)
  - id: B
    description: >-
      Narrow consequence 3 to the non-elevated remainder the normative sources allow: only the running gov binary's
      own capability server (`capabilities serve-embed`, OS-provided code whose effects are the release's own) runs
      hand-declared, for roles at/above TOOL_POLICY.plugins.min_authority; every other (executable) plugin runs only
      with an OS-written, T2-verified registration approved by an owner-answered Human Decision Gate raised for exactly
      that plugin identity, version, implementation and permission set, re-verified at every execution; the
      registration's implementation binding replaces the per-version first-observed hash
chosen_option: B
rationale: |
  The contradiction is between an orchestrator-approved record (D-0005, 2026-09-12) and the normative sources that
  bind it: Contract v3 F4 (the capability acceptance contract) and ARCH-0003 §9 (owner-adopted, OWNER-DECISION-0009).
  An orchestrator decision cannot relax either, so the record must be brought into conformance; the audit-0 synthesis
  (owner-decisions-required.md row 2) determined this, and the repair implemented it (BC-P2-39: elevation is never
